baseline_models.focus_anchor: The negated knowing at word 2 governs the passive concealment at word 5; the concealed item is for beneficiaries and is framed as eye-settling recompense for prior action.
baseline_models.mechanism: Knowing would unveil, concealment withholds, and recompense answers purposive work. The eye term makes eventual disclosure experiential: a real matched return exists before any self can inspect it.

activation_trace.role: Knowing contributes disclosure to a knower; the opening negation blocks that disclosure at the present reader position.
Concealment supplies the present covering of the promised return.
Direct ocular witnessing supplies the eventual mode in which the presently unknowable return can be verified.
Reciprocal answering of an act identifies the concealed item as matched consequence rather than an arbitrary gift.
Purposive action supplies the human input to which the concealed consequence answers.

changed_reading.before: An unspecified future pleasure is simply unknown.
changed_reading.after: A matched consequence is already reserved for the doers but remains inaccessible to creaturely knowing until it becomes directly experienced.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: A living self at word 3 cannot know a reward named through cooling, settling, and eyes at words 8-9.
baseline_models.mechanism: The self is treated as embodied life, while the eye phrase joins thermal cooling to cessation of visual agitation. Recompense is therefore not only information or possession but relief that changes the body's state.

activation_trace.role: The life-bearing self supplies the whole embodied recipient rather than a detached intellect.
Relief that opens constriction supplies a transition from distress to bodily ease.
Coolness contributes a literal thermal counterstate to strain and heat.
The eye's settling contributes cessation of restless looking and affective agitation.
The seeing organ localizes the promised relief in bodily perception.

changed_reading.before: Eye comfort is only a conventional synonym for happiness.
changed_reading.after: The concealed reward is embodied decompression: the living self moves from constriction, heat, and restless sight into cooled and settled perception.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The concealment root at word 5 carries both covering and removal-of-covering branches, between blocked knowledge and eventual eye experience.
baseline_models.mechanism: The opposed branches inside the concealment inventory create a temporal hinge. What is covered now is not inert absence; it can be held for a later extracting or showing that establishes what the eye directly encounters.

activation_trace.role: Covering supplies the first phase in which the return is unavailable.
Removal of covering supplies a root-internal counterphase of extraction or manifestation.
Unveiling to a knower marks the epistemic change produced when concealment ends.
Eyewitness encounter supplies the terminal disclosed phase.
Stability supplies the durable state reached after manifestation rather than a momentary glimpse.

changed_reading.before: Hiddenness is a static property of an absent object.
changed_reading.after: Hiddenness is the first phase of a staged disclosure: withheld from knowing now, then manifested to sight and established as a lasting condition.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The recompense word at 10 resolves both to the ordinary reciprocation root and to a non-dominant cutting root whose branch marks harvest time, beside purposive work at 13.
baseline_models.mechanism: Ordinary recompense remains primary, but the split mapping adds a form-distant harvest clock: action functions as cultivation, the return remains hidden while maturing, and its due moment is like produce becoming ready to cut.

activation_trace.role: The dominant mapping supplies recompense that answers an act.
The non-dominant mapping contributes the time when growth has ripened enough for cutting or harvest.
Intentional work supplies the cultivation-like input whose return matures.
Settling and establishment contribute the attainment of a mature stable state.

changed_reading.before: Reward is an immediate-looking entry in a moral ledger.
changed_reading.after: Reward can also be carried as a ripening return: work is planted, its result is hidden through maturation, and recompense arrives at harvest time.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier knower of the unseen and witnessed revises the focus negation from universal unknowability to an asymmetry. The reward is hidden from every creaturely self while remaining within a knowledge that spans both concealed and present domains.

activation_trace.role: The focus blocks disclosure to any self and supplies one side of the knowledge asymmetry.
Focus concealment locates the promised return on the unseen side of the contrast.
The context supplies a knower characterized by disclosure rather than the focus self whose knowing is negated.
The unseen contributes a domain screened from eyes, matching the focus's withheld object.
Presence with witnessing supplies the disclosed counterpart toward which the hidden reward can later move.

structural_cues: At 32:6 the knower, unseen, and witnessed occur in one compact predication; 32:17 reverses that arrangement by negating a self's knowing before naming concealment.
The focus passive leaves the concealer unstated, so the earlier epistemic subject remains relevant without being grammatically forced as an explicit agent.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an all-domain knower at 32:6 and a no-self-knows construction at 32:17; I align them on one epistemic axis and infer custodial knowledge of the hidden provision. A live alternative is that 32:6 only magnifies unknowability without implying preparation.

changed_reading.before: The reward is unknown without qualification.
changed_reading.after: The reward is unknown to creaturely selves but not unheld or indeterminate; concealment marks asymmetric access between unseen knowledge and later witness.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding bodies separate from beds, call in expectant desire, and send out allotted provision. The focus reward becomes a reciprocal completion: relinquished rest and resources are answered by a concealed gift that settles the perceiving self.

activation_trace.role: The eye's settling supplies restored rest as the answering state.
Reciprocal recompense provides the directional link from relinquishment to answering gift.
A thing pulling away from attachment supplies the body's active separation from accustomed rest.
The side adhering to a resting surface supplies the bodily comfort being left.
The heart's hopeful desire supplies orientation toward a not-yet-visible good.
An apportioned gift supplies the resource first received before some of it is released.
The outward departure of wealth supplies the concrete relinquishment answered by concealed recompense.

structural_cues: 32:16 immediately precedes the focus, and 32:17 opens with connective fa, making the no-knowing claim read as a consequence or continuation.
The preceding verse pairs bodily displacement with outward expenditure before the focus pairs hidden provision with settled eyes.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies separation from beds, hopeful calling, received provision, expenditure, and then recompense; I supply the reciprocal arrow from surrendered comfort and resources to restored rest and gift. The live alternative is simple eligibility rather than material inversion.

changed_reading.before: The hidden item is a generic prize after devotion.
changed_reading.after: The hidden item answers the exact shape of devotion: nocturnal bodily unrest and released provision are reciprocated as settled perception and provision held in reserve.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier failed actors see and hear, request a return so they can act, and then receive an outcome described as tasting because of their action. Against that sequence, eye-settling recompense is the positive sensory realization of action, not an abstract credit entry.

activation_trace.role: Settling of the eye supplies the positive sensory endpoint.
The bodily organ of sight makes recompense perceptually realized.
Recompense binds sensory outcome to prior action.
Actual seeing supplies a late perception that precedes the speakers' request to act again.
Auditory perception joins sight in making consequence experientially undeniable.
Purposive work is requested only after perception, exposing the lost order between action and consequence.
Experiential testing supplies the negative pole in which consequence is undergone rather than merely announced.
Intentional action supplies the cause attached to the negative sensory outcome, paralleling the focus close.

structural_cues: 32:12 orders seeing and hearing before a request for renewed action.
32:14 and 32:17 attach opposed sensory outcomes to action with closely parallel causal endings.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the sight-hearing-action order and the taste/action versus eye-settling/action parallel; I infer a shared mechanism in which deeds become embodied experience. A live alternative treats the sensory terms as independent rhetoric with no common conversion mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Recompense is an external award correlated with deeds.
changed_reading.after: Recompense is deeds becoming lived perception: one sequence is tasted as harm, while the concealed positive sequence settles the eyes.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later action-parallel verse supplies an enclosed garden, gathering refuge, and prepared reception for an arriving guest. The focus's hidden object therefore expands into hosted arrival and inhabitable protection, not merely a private object shown to the eyes.

activation_trace.role: Concealment supplies the presently closed status of the prepared destination.
Stable settlement supplies the experiential result of entering a lasting refuge.
An enclosed, tree-screened garden supplies a protected environment whose richness is partly concealed by its own cover.
Gathering into a sheltering direction supplies the movement from exposure into refuge.
Provision prepared for an arriving guest supplies hospitality rather than bare payment.
Purposive action repeats the focus's causal basis and licenses the later spatial images as an expansion of its recompense.

structural_cues: 32:19 repeats the focus's action-based close and plural beneficiary structure while supplying explicit spatial predicates.
32:18 first separates two kinds of persons, so the refuge in 32:19 functions as the positive branch of the same contrast.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated action formula plus garden, refuge, and guest-provision images; I infer that these specify the hidden reward's reception mechanism. A live alternative is that 32:19 names a separate consequence without unpacking the focus image.

changed_reading.before: What is hidden is a collection of delightful objects.
changed_reading.after: What is hidden is also a mode of reception: the doers are gathered into protected, stable hospitality already prepared for their arrival.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later sequence drives water to cut-off ground, brings out growth, and ends by demanding sight. It activates the focus's non-dominant harvest-time branch: deeds can be read as latent cultivation, concealment as the growth interval, and recompense as emergence at ripeness.

activation_trace.role: The split-root branch supplies ripeness for cutting as a form-distant clock inside the recompense word.
Extraction from concealment supplies the emergence phase of latent growth.
Intentional work supplies the cultivation-like input that precedes maturation.
Directed watering supplies the material input that enables hidden potential to develop.
Ground stripped of vegetation supplies the apparently unproductive starting state.
Bringing something out of concealment supplies the causal transition from latency to visibility.
Germination and growth supply the developmental process between work and outcome.
Harvest supplies the mature terminal phase that answers the split branch in the focus recompense word.
The closing appeal to eyesight turns emergence into a visible sign and reconnects the growth cycle to the focus eye anchor.

structural_cues: 32:27 presents a complete causal chain: directed water, barren ground, brought-out crop, nourishment, then an appeal to sight.
The focus orders work before concealed recompense, matching the latent interval between cultivation and visible harvest.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the split harvest branch and the later water-to-crop emergence sequence; I treat deeds as cultivation and hidden recompense as maturation below the visible threshold. A live alternative is that 32:27 concerns revival alone and does not materially redescribe 32:17.

changed_reading.before: Reward is a completed payment merely kept out of view.
changed_reading.after: Reward is also a living return under development: action initiates cultivation, concealment holds the ripening interval, and recompense emerges as a harvest visible to the eyes.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it combines remote nominal water branches across four focus roots rather than following the direct syntax. It remains valid as a focus-anchored material analogy: every component attaches to a cited focus word and coheres as collection, concealment, cooling, and release. Downstream prose should label it an exploratory hydraulic model, never a lexical translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus clusters knowing, a life-bearing self, concealment, cooling or settling, and eyes, whose inventories also cluster stored water, sustaining water, and a flowing spring.

activation_trace.role: A large collected body of water supplies the image of an abundant reserve not exhausted by one recipient.
Water sufficient to sustain life supplies the reserve's recipient-facing function.
Covering supplies the reservoir's presently inaccessible state.
Cold water supplies the cooling effect of release.
A low basin where material settles supplies containment and stable collection.
A flowing spring supplies the transition from hidden reserve to accessible life-giving outflow.

changed_reading.before: The hidden good is a static treasure perceived only at the end.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the hidden good behaves like a collected life-giving reserve: contained beyond present access, then released as cooling flow that settles and revives the recipient.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates commercial and juridical side branches in an affective promise and because the eye form need not carry the cash sense. It remains anchored in the contiguous focus sequence of concealment, settling, recompense, and work. Downstream prose should present it only as a deferred-account analogy alongside, not instead of, the ordinary eye-comfort reading.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Words 5 and 8-13 place a hidden item beside confirmation, present value, debt settlement, recompense, and wages within their supplied branch inventories.

activation_trace.role: Concealment supplies the deferred, presently unavailable status of the account's value.
Formal confirmation or acknowledgment supplies settlement of what is due.
Present cash as opposed to absent debt supplies conversion from deferred claim to available value.
Collection and satisfaction of a debt supplies the account-closing mechanism.
Wages for labor supply the basis on which value has accrued.

changed_reading.before: The reward is an unstructured surprise unrelated to accrual.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the reward is a deferred account: work accrues a due return that remains hidden until acknowledged, settled, and converted into present value.

strongest_changes: 32:6 changes unqualified unknowability into asymmetric access: hidden from every self, yet held within knowledge spanning unseen and witnessed domains.
32:16 changes generic reward into reciprocal restoration of the exact rest and provision relinquished in nocturnal devotion.
32:12-14 make the consequence of action sensory, while 32:19 expands the hidden good into prepared, sheltering hospitality.
32:27 activates the non-dominant harvest branch so work, concealment, and recompense can form a cultivation-ripening-emergence sequence.
summary.what_was_special: The focus's own branch structure already held two unusually productive tensions: concealment versus removal of concealment, and ordinary recompense versus the split-root image of harvest at ripeness. Context did not collapse them; it made both functional, while the water-bearing side branches preserved a separate hydraulic outlier.
remaining_uncertainties: The removal-of-concealment branch may function only as a root-level counterimage and need not color the passive focus form directly.
The harvest model depends on a non-dominant mapped root and a reader-supplied cross-domain link, so it should remain beside rather than replace ordinary recompense.
The conventional eye-comfort construction may dampen the thermal, hydraulic, and financial side branches even though each remains packet-anchored.
The later refuge and crop sequences may elaborate the focus promise, or they may be independent examples sharing only the action-consequence frame.
